newsitem.title: INDIA: Several dozen feared dead in India flash floods.
newsitem.headline: Several dozen feared dead in India flash floods.

text.p: Several dozen people were missing and feared dead on Tuesday after flash floods swept through a remote Himalayan region in northern India, police said.
Monsoon rains triggered the flooding in the Chirgaon region of the northern state of Himachal Pradesh, they said.
"Preliminary reports suggest that 43 people have been washed away," deputy police chief Rakesh Aggarwal told Reuters by telephone from the state capital Shimla.
Chirgaon is about 125 km (80 miles) east of Shimla in the Himalayan mountains.
United News of India (UNI) said about 40 people were feared drowned and 15 to 20 injured after the Andhra River burst its banks and rushed through one village.
Local police told Reuters they did not yet know the exact number of casualties.
The news agency said raging river water damaged many buildings, washed away roads and drowned farm animals.
